name: 螳螂人（武器与灵能）Thri-kreen (Weapons and Psionics) (MM'14)

biography.value:
螳螂人避开其他种族，独自漫步在荒漠和大草原之中。

螳螂人通讯Thri-Kreen Communication。螳螂人会使用一种没有词汇的语言。螳螂人通过敲击自己下颚齿及摆动其触角来表达情绪和表示应，以让其他螳螂人知晓自己的想法和感受。其他生物会觉得这种通讯方式难以翻译和复制。
而当迫切需要与其他智能生物进行交互时，螳螂人会使用另一种替代的通讯方式。比如在沙子上画图或者用小树枝和草叶拼成图像。

有限情感Limited Emotions。螳螂人富有的情感，但是它们并不擅长像人类那样鲜明的表达。拥有灵能的螳螂人通常会具有更多一点的情感表现，尤其当它们与人类或其他情感丰富的种族邻近或一同生活时更是如此。

孤独者与漫游者Isolationists and Wanderers。螳螂人将所有其他活体生物看作潜在的食物。它们尤其喜欢精灵血肉的滋味。如果某生物除作为食物外还有重大的用途，那螳螂人就不会立即对其发动攻击。螳螂人只为生存而杀戮，他们不以之取乐。

不眠Sleepless。螳螂人不需要睡眠。他们可以在保持警戒或者进行简单工作的时候休息。他们短暂的生命有时候也被归咎于这种不良的睡眠习惯。通常情况下，螳螂人从出生到死亡只能活三十年。

Thri-kreen wander the deserts and savannas of the world, avoiding all other races.

Thri-Kreen Communication. Thri-kreen employ a language without words. To show emotion and reaction, a thri-kreen clacks its mandibles and waves its antennae, giving other thri-kreen a sense of what it is thinking and feeling. Other creatures find this manner of communication difficult to interpret and impossible to duplicate.

When forced to interact with creatures of other intelligent species, thri-kreen employ alternative methods of communication, such as drawing pictures in sand or making pictures out of twigs or blades of grass.

Limited Emotions. Thri-kreen experience the full range of emotions but aren't as prone to emotional outbursts as humans. Thri-kreen with psionic ability often demonstrate a wider range of emotions, particularly if they live near or interact with humans or other highly emotional creatures.

Isolationists and Wanderers. Thri-kreen consider all other living creatures as potential nourishment, and they love the taste of elf flesh in particular. If a creature might be useful for something other than food, the thri-kreen aren't likely to attack it on sight. Thri-kreen kill to survive, never for sport.

Sleepless. Thri-kreen don't require sleep and can rest while remaining alert and performing light tasks. Their inability to sleep is thought to be the reason why thri-kreen have such short lifespans, the average thri-kreen life expectancy being only thirty years.

description.value:
螳螂人发动两次攻击。一次啃咬，一次爪击。

The thri-kreen makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

螳螂人发动两次螳螂戟攻击或两次三棱梭攻击。

The thri-kreen makes two gythka attacks or two chatkcha attacks.

近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d8+1）点挥砍伤害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+3]]{+3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 ([[/damage 1d8 + 1 type=slashing]]) damage.

远程武器攻击：命中+4，射程30/120尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d6+2）点挥砍伤害。

Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 ([[/damage 1d6 + 2 type=slashing]]) damage.

A creature you touch becomes &Reference[condition=invisible] until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is &Reference[condition=invisible] as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

materials.value: an eyelash encased in gum arabic

effects.name: Invisibility
effects.description: The target becomes Invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

description.value: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with &Reference[rule=truesight].

You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

effects.name: Magic Weapon, +1
effects.description: This weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls.

effects.name: Magic Weapon, +2
effects.description: This weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +2 bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls.

effects.name: Magic Weapon, +3
effects.description: This weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +3 bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls.

description.value:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

螳螂人天生施法属性为智力。螳螂人天生可以施展以下法术而无需任何相应的法术成分。

Innate Spellcasting (Psionics). The thri-kreen's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. The thri-kreen can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

  • At will: @UUID[.CSzSPahlKG8IIWz3] (the hand is &Reference[condition=invisible])

  • 2/day each: @UUID[.WyXUwb4CMjJOqDxq], @UUID[.KgKksOVp3Pl4XQ2J]

  • 1/day: @UUID[.JeZTNas0uZ0WkBIr] (self only)

螳螂人可以改变外壳的颜色来模拟周围环境的色调和质感。因此，它进行敏捷（隐匿）检定时具有优势。

The thri-kreen can change the color of its carapace to match the color and texture of its surroundings. As a result, it has advantage on Dexterity (&Reference[skill=Stealth]) checks made to hide.

螳螂人助跑或不助跑时，其跳远都可达到至多30尺，条高可达15尺。

The thri-kreen's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及3尺，单一生物。命中：4（1d6+1）点穿刺伤害。目标必须成功通过一次DC 11的体质豁免，否则将中毒1分钟。若豁免失败且差值为5或更高，则目标在中毒的同时陷入麻痹。该中毒目标可以在每个其自己的回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则效应终止。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+3]]{+3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 ([[/damage 1d6 + 1 type=piercing]]) damage, and the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=11]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=poisoned] for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also &Reference[condition=paralyzed] while &Reference[condition=poisoned] in this way. The &Reference[condition=poisoned] target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：6（2d4+1）点挥砍伤害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+3]]{+3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 ([[/damage 2d4 + 1 type=slashing]]) damage.
